findings.desc: quality: packages/main/src/tasks/native-review-fixture.ts:184 and packages/main/src/tasks/review-pass-discard-smoke.ts:135 inherit LATTICE_MANAGED_HOST_RUN_ID/LATTICE_AGENT into isolated native and ordinary fixture children. In a real managed reviewer, review_pass_set is rejected as direct managed evidence; after clearing only managed vars, checklist_update is still denied as lattice-review-quality. The mapped smoke therefore cannot run under the supported managed-review execution boundary. Build a sanitized fixture environment that removes managed-review capability/run and ambient reviewer authority variables before adding only the fixture's broker identity, and cover this nesting case.

readManifest.scanEscalationReason: A reproducible managed-context smoke failure narrowed the evidence review to authority-propagation paths; additional managed-run and documentation surfaces were reviewed through targeted diff and smoke output.
